Your New Social Wellness Club
Virgin Active Clapham sits on the edge of the Common, one of London’s most-loved green spaces and a stone’s throw from Clapham Common tube station.
A neighbourhood hangout, as well as a performance-focused training hub, it’s a space to discover wellness your way. Whether you choose something that gets you sweating - like Lift Club, Boxing or a session in our Eleiko free weights gym - or something that soothes your soul - like downtime with your favourite people.
Join the club
